title: Step 7: once created, the same fields get new names in Edit session ('Session code', 'Topic', 'Summarize · system prompt')
where: /admin/sessions/<code> → Edit session (edit-session-form.tsx:251-350, :112), vs the chat draft and create form
what_happens: The draft and the create form say 'Link name', 'Question people are asked' and 'Summary focus'. After creating, Edit session calls the same fields 'Session code', 'Topic' and 'Summarize · system prompt' (the last one inside the advanced prompt list).
who_hurts: An admin who wants to fix something right after creating: can't match what they wrote to the fields, and may not find their summary focus at all.
suggested_fix: Use the create form's labels in edit-session-form.tsx (Link name, Question people are asked, Summary focus).
rule: established pattern: create form labels; Dane agreed earlier 'Same thing called … in different places'
